hazards.hazard: False negative — tool fails to detect a safety-critical coding violation
hazards.safetyGoal: The tool shall detect all MUST-check rules listed in the x-FuSa spec §9.1 with no systematic omission

hazards.hazard: False positive — tool reports a violation that does not exist
hazards.safetyGoal: False positive rate shall not cause users to disable the tool

hazards.hazard: Non-deterministic fingerprint — same finding produces different fingerprints across runs
hazards.safetyGoal: The fingerprint algorithm shall be deterministic per §4.2

hazards.hazard: Incorrect exit code — gate failure not reported as exit 1
hazards.safetyGoal: Exit codes shall conform to §2.3 in all circumstances
